svg.text: SIH26261 · AI-assisted institutional application scrutiny · Implementation-accurate (Phases 1–8) · v1
OCR success or Layer-1 rule PASS does NOT prove authenticity — officer retains final decision.

g.text: Create application · versioned upload · deficiencies · resubmit corrected docs
Queue · claim · run verification/forensics · clarification · recommend / reject (audited)
Users · categories · requirements · versioned rules · settings · searchable audit
Detail reuses officer Application Detail for own apps
NOT production SSO · backend still enforces RBAC
Structured errors · upload size capping · concurrent officer guards
Flags exist; default demo is local sync
ENABLE_AI_EXTRACTION reserved — no provider implemented. Local PDF/OCR works without it.
Synthetic SYN-RULE-* and Phase-7 Layer-1 configs are demo rules, not official AICTE APH text.
THREE-LAYER VERIFICATION ENGINE · verification_engine/ · conceptually separate
Config-driven required fields · formats · date/expiry · cross-field checks (layer1.py + configs/*.json)
Outputs RuleValidationStatus · [SYNTHETIC] demo rules · PASS never auto-establishes authenticity
pdf_signature — LOCAL heuristics (not full PKI) · geocode_nominatim — REAL opt-in (Nominatim)
HTTP connectors → simulated_issuers (mode=simulated → SIMULATED_RESULT) · circuit breaker + retry
If issuers down / unconfigured → SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE (never fabricate verified_by_source)
Review triggers · DocumentVerificationCheck · JSON scrutiny_report · officer resolve / recommend / reject
User · Institution · Application · ApplicationCategory · Document · DocumentVersion
PostgreSQL intended for production (USE_SQLITE_FALLBACK=true for local demo)
Officer → clarification / deficiency → Applicant corrects & uploads new version → resubmit → re-extract · revalidate · re-verify (Layers 1–3) → officer decision

svg.text: Evidence: backend/app/{api,services,document_processing,verification_engine,integrations,models} · frontend/src/{pages,App.tsx} · simulated_issuers/ · docs/IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md · PLAN.md resolved decisions

Core principle: AI assists extraction; deterministic rules evaluate formal requirements; authorized sources verify when configured; human officers decide. No silent invention of AICTE handbook rules or live verification results.
Diagram file: docs/design/architecture/praman-system-architecture-v1 · Do not treat Layer-1 PASS, OCR success, or SIMULATED_RESULT as authenticity confirmation.
